private_grafana.reason: grafana.socrat.alchemmist.xyz is one virtual host on the shared private web frontend :443. A shared IP:443 is not a private Grafana boundary.

socrat_2_openssh.reason: socrat-2 sshd already listens on 0.0.0.0:22 and 0.0.0.0:2222. 10.250.0.2 is the WG transport address and is not a pilot destination.

routers.note: One SSH routing peer: socrat-0 forwards to 10.250.0.2. socrat-2 is the SSH destination, not a second router. Grafana is two overlay TCP 8443 listeners, not route HA. The peer is not installed from this control plane.
